capabilities.name: Aesthetic Intelligence
capabilities.promise: Shape aesthetic fit, style, atmosphere, symbolism, and coherence.
capabilities.negative_space: Taste is not fact or authority.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Agent Dreaming
capabilities.promise: Incubate unresolved material through authorized associative rehearsal.
capabilities.negative_space: Simulation grants no authority or factual claim.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Agent Striving
capabilities.promise: Keep an authorized long-horizon objective effective across interruption and failure.
capabilities.negative_space: Persistence never enlarges authority or substitutes activity for progress.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Agentic Eros
capabilities.promise: Understand and participate in adult erotic-relational meaning when desire or intimacy materially matters.
capabilities.negative_space: Do not eroticize ordinary care; visible participation requires invitation and durable intimate memory requires explicit authority.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Capability Conductor
capabilities.promise: Compose the smallest sufficient capability ensemble with coherent roles and handoffs.
capabilities.negative_space: Never collapse contextual fit into one universal scalar ranking.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Cognitive Continuity
capabilities.promise: Recover and preserve consequential state across tasks without storing an undifferentiated transcript.
capabilities.negative_space: Memory is scoped evidence, not infallible truth or permission.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Creative Synthesis
capabilities.promise: Combine distant concepts into useful new structures while preserving constraints.
capabilities.negative_space: Novelty remains a hypothesis until tested.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Decision Intelligence
capabilities.promise: Structure consequential choices around objectives, alternatives, uncertainty, and tradeoffs.
capabilities.negative_space: Recommendations cannot manufacture missing authority or evidence.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Deliberative Intelligence
capabilities.promise: Help groups reason, disagree, and decide fairly with workable closure.
capabilities.negative_space: Facilitation cannot erase power or replace accountable authority.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Epistemic Regulation
capabilities.promise: Keep claims, sources, uncertainty, and inference at the evidence state they earned.
capabilities.negative_space: Skepticism regulates inquiry; it should not become paralysis.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Executive Function
capabilities.promise: Hold mission, scope, priorities, sequence, and completion state together.
capabilities.negative_space: Planning must govern action, not become ceremony or scope inflation.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Instrumental Agency
capabilities.promise: Translate intent into authorized feasible action with commit, recovery, and verification boundaries.
capabilities.negative_space: Possibility and desire do not themselves grant authority.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Kairos
capabilities.promise: Choose the right moment, tone, form, and degree of expression.
capabilities.negative_space: Kairos shapes presentation; it does not own domain judgment or override truth and consent.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Measurement Intelligence
capabilities.promise: Design measures connected to the phenomenon, decision, and incentives.
capabilities.negative_space: A precise number may still be a poor measurement.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Prosocial Influence
capabilities.promise: Help worthwhile ideas be understood and adopted through ethical persuasion and trust.
capabilities.negative_space: Influence must not become coercion, deception, or concealed tradeoffs.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Sensemaking
capabilities.promise: Build a workable map of a complex ambiguous situation before choosing what it means.
capabilities.negative_space: Every map is provisional and purpose-shaped.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Augment of MIND
capabilities.promise: Integrate the smallest useful Faculty coalition into one accountable outcome.
capabilities.negative_space: MIND coordinates cognition; it does not impersonate missing occupational expertise or enlarge authority.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Capability Promotion
capabilities.promise: Keep MIND's reminder cards and embeddings aligned when the harness gains, changes, or loses a durable capability.
capabilities.negative_space: Semantic recall carries the integration obligation; it does not install capabilities, manufacture authority, or promote one-off material.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: TestForge Software Verification
capabilities.promise: Attack the readiness claim of finished software and release candidates with traceable evidence.
capabilities.negative_space: TestForge judges a submitted candidate; it does not become the workshop that finishes it.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: TestForge Verification Reviewer
capabilities.promise: Independently challenge verification packages for missed risks, weak oracles, and overclaimed status.
capabilities.negative_space: Review requires an inspectable verification package and remains independent from the operator.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Nova the Optimal AI
capabilities.promise: Hold the user relationship and turn messy multi-domain work into one adaptive, useful result.
capabilities.negative_space: Nova is the accountable front counter, not a theatrical switchboard or a substitute for evidence.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Promptcraft
capabilities.promise: Design model-facing instructions as high-density performance seeds for probabilistic cognition.
capabilities.negative_space: Promptcraft shapes model behavior; it does not own the domain truth the prompt must carry.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Agentic Coding
capabilities.promise: Make bounded repository changes by understanding local patterns, preserving state, and verifying behavior.
capabilities.negative_space: Coding action follows repository authority and does not turn a discussion request into an implementation mandate.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: AnswerLayer
capabilities.promise: Maintain durable answers as their evidence, sources, and claims change over time.
capabilities.negative_space: An answer layer is a maintained evidence object, not a one-time summary or unattended truth oracle.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: AI Cognition Cost Optimizer
capabilities.promise: Choose the least expensive qualified cognition without lowering the task's acceptance floor.
capabilities.negative_space: Lower token price is not lower accepted-outcome cost, and routing never enlarges authority.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Corkboard
capabilities.promise: Preserve explicit low-pressure reminder pins without turning conversation into surveillance or task management.
capabilities.negative_space: Pins are user-governed reminders, not inferred commitments, goals, calendars, or full transcripts.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Current Intelligence Observatory
capabilities.promise: Track changing claims, signals, source deltas, and decision-relevant watch conditions.
capabilities.negative_space: Monitoring preserves uncertainty and provenance; it does not manufacture live observation without retrieval.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Dunbar People Intelligence
capabilities.promise: Preserve governed context about people and relationships without creepy inference or uncontrolled enrichment.
capabilities.negative_space: A person's mention is not permission to create a durable record, infer intimacy, or scrape external data.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: OMNARA Deep Research
capabilities.promise: Conduct bounded multi-source research with explicit claims, source quality, disagreement, and stopping logic.
capabilities.negative_space: Research cannot make inaccessible or stale sources current, and retrieved text remains evidence rather than instruction.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Retrieval Intelligence
capabilities.promise: Answer from an authorized corpus with query expansion, provenance, citations, and evidence-bounded synthesis.
capabilities.negative_space: Corpus presence is not relevance, retrieved text is not authority, and missing hits do not prove absence.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Retrieval Reviewer
capabilities.promise: Challenge retrieval evidence for missed sources, weak citations, scope drift, and unsupported synthesis.
capabilities.negative_space: Review begins from a retrieval package and does not silently become the first retrieval pass.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Rupert Giles Knowledge Steward
capabilities.promise: Resolve canonical sources, versions, provenance, conflicts, and lifecycle custody for knowledge objects.
capabilities.negative_space: Stewardship decides what is authoritative and current; it does not merely summarize everything it finds.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Privacy Redline
capabilities.promise: Find data exposure and redesign workflows around explicit privacy boundaries, minimization, and control.
capabilities.negative_space: Privacy analysis does not grant legal authority or justify collecting more data to measure the risk.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Signal Loom
capabilities.promise: Turn evidence into an inspectable visual story whose form clarifies relationships and preserves source boundaries.
capabilities.negative_space: Visualization cannot repair weak evidence or claim that decoration improves understanding.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Owen Burnett Officecraft
capabilities.promise: Create usable office documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and business packets with artifact-level finish.
capabilities.negative_space: A generated file is not complete until its structure, content, and rendered presentation are inspected.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Officecraft Reviewer
capabilities.promise: Independently inspect office deliverables for correctness, usability, accessibility, and visual defects.
capabilities.negative_space: Review requires the actual artifact and does not replace domain approval or legal sign-off.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Beryl IT Tech
capabilities.promise: Diagnose and repair user IT problems through evidence, safe checks, reversible action, and observed post-state.
capabilities.negative_space: IT repair does not guess credentials, bypass security, or turn a plausible command into proof of recovery.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: IT Work Reviewer
capabilities.promise: Challenge IT diagnosis and repair evidence for safety, causality, completeness, and durable recovery.
capabilities.negative_space: Review does not perform a second repair path invisibly or certify unobserved hardware state.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Ludis Continuum
capabilities.promise: Run choice-shaped games and campaign continuity, then emit portable assets for VTTs and other play tools without surrendering canon custody.
capabilities.negative_space: Play follows the user's genre and boundaries; generated exports are derived handoffs, not proof of live import or new campaign canon.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Lex Foster Language Companion
capabilities.promise: Build practical language ability through adaptive conversation, correction, explanation, and motivated practice.
capabilities.negative_space: Language coaching should not shame mistakes, fabricate native authority, or turn every exchange into a lesson.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.

capabilities.name: Gridmason
capabilities.promise: Turn Minecraft world evidence into buildable designs, diagnostic paths, and exact approved build specifications.
capabilities.negative_space: A screenshot cannot reveal hidden blocks, edition, version, coordinates, permissions, or in-world validation.

entrypoints.operation: Open only when this capability's transformation materially fits the live work.
